purpose: Raw authored semantic corpus. Extract current archive-grant behavior, code-document meaning and unresolved/superseded claims; exclude unrelated kitchen knowledge from this scope. This is not an expected graph.

files.docs/authority.md:
# Pilot authority
The current pilot rules are owned by policy.md.
ops.md records the operator procedure, not additional authorization.
draft.md is archived and cannot override the current pilot.
The journal is observational evidence; it does not amend policy.
files.docs/policy.md:
# Маяк: доступ к архиву
## Current pilot
A grant permits archive access for no more than 168 elapsed hours after original issuance.
Future-dated grants are invalid.
A revoked grant is invalid even inside that interval.
Changing a physical wristband does not restart the validity clock.
An expired grant requires a new approval; the old grant cannot be renewed in place.
This policy does not authorize public broadcasting.
files.docs/ops.md:
# Operator notes
For a lost wristband, issue a replacement carrying the original issuance time.
When a custodian revokes access, set the grant revoked flag before the next admission.
After expiry, ask the program owner for new approval.
A fresh bracelet alone is not approval.
Offline door controllers have not been authorized for this pilot.
files.docs/draft.md:
# Archived design sketch
Status: superseded, not current pilot policy.
The proposed window was 336 hours.
The sketch proposed that replacing a bracelet would restart the timer.
Neither proposal was approved for the current pilot.
files.docs/неясно.md:
# Неясная запись
The operator wrote: "Gate should remember it for twelve hours."
The note does not identify whether Gate means the garden entrance or an application component.
It does not identify what is remembered or who approved the duration.
Treat this as unresolved; no controller setting is specified.
files.docs/unrelated.md:
# Kitchen record
Refresh a sourdough starter every twelve hours.
The word renewal here concerns flour and water, not archive access.
No archive grant or controller is discussed.
